verses.text: The king's heart is in the LORD's hand like a stream he can channel wherever he wants.
Everybody thinks their own way is right. The LORD weighs what's in their hearts.
Doing what's right and fair pleases the LORD more than offering a sacrifice.
Looking down on people and carrying a proud heart light the way for the wicked. It's sin.
People who work hard and plan carefully will get ahead. People who rush into everything are rushing into poverty.
Get rich by lying and your treasure will vanish like mist. That's a way of chasing death.
The violence of the wicked will sweep them away because they refuse to do right.
Guilty people take twisted routes. The innocent go about things honestly.
Better to live in a corner up on the roof than share a house with a woman who's always picking fights.
The wicked crave evil deep down. Their neighbors can't count on them for any mercy.
Punish a mocker and people who are easily led can learn some wisdom. Teach someone wise and they'll pick up knowledge.
The Righteous One watches the household of the wicked and brings the wicked down.
Shut your ears when poor people cry for help and one day you'll cry out with nobody to hear you.
A gift given quietly can cool anger. A bribe tucked inside a coat can calm even somebody furious.
Doing justice makes people who do right glad. It brings ruin to people who do wrong.
Wander off the road of understanding and you'll end up resting in the company of the dead.
Live for pleasure and you'll end up poor. Love your wine and oil and you won't get rich.
The wicked become the ransom for people who do right. Those who betray others take the place of the upright.
Better to live out in the desert than share a home with a woman who's quarrelsome and irritable.
Wise people keep precious things and oil at home. A fool goes through it all.
Chase after doing right and showing kindness, and you'll find life, righteousness, and honor.
A wise person can climb into a city full of mighty people and tear down the defenses they were counting on.
Watch your mouth and keep your tongue in check, and you'll save yourself a lot of trouble.
Call the proud, arrogant person a mocker. Everything they do shows how full of themselves they are.
What a lazy person craves ends up killing them because their hands won't get to work.
Some people spend all day wanting more. People who do right give without holding back.
A sacrifice from the wicked is disgusting. How much worse when they bring it with an evil plan in mind!
A false witness will perish. The words of someone who listens will last.
The wicked put on a defiant face. Honest people make sure of the road they're taking.
No wisdom, insight, or advice can stand against the LORD.
You can get the horse ready for battle day, but the victory comes from the LORD.
